note: The happy path for `presentation.hub`. A recognised token normalizes to the closed enum with no diagnostic at all, and `presentation` appears in the canonical result because the manifest declared it. The companion assertion is what this fixture cannot show on its own: every other fixture here omits `presentation` from its result, which is how a browser tells 'the site asked for the default' from 'the site said nothing'. A non-nullable holder would put a `presentation` object into all of them, including bloom-flowers.expected.json, whose body is pinned by SHA-256 in two repositories.
